up: Find the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5050844 in the docs table. Then retrieve all compounds that are linked to that document via the compound_records table (using doc_id). For each such compound, return its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary) and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures). Ensure the results are distinct to avoid duplicates from multiple records.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5050844';
